subject: Founders Edge batch — request for partner top-up credits and issuance process
messages:
From: Sarah Ngo <sarah@foundersedge.vc>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: cohort top-up — 50k credits per company?

Hi Dev,

Hope you’re well — Founders Edge runs a winter cohort (starting mid-Nov) and we'd like to offer Redwood credits to every accepted company. Can Redwood do a partner top-up of 50,000 credits per company for the cohort (approximately 12 companies)? We prefer a self-serve issuance so founders can redeem directly.

What we can provide today: cohort roster, signed partnership letter from our director, and company basic info (incorporation jurisdiction, lead founder email).

Please let me know the eligibility checklist and any limits (per-company cap, total program cap, expiry). If there’s a short form we can fill that’s even better.

Thanks — looking forward to making this simple for the founders.

—Sarah
Sarah Ngo | Programs Director
Founders Edge Accelerator
[sarah@foundersedge.vc]

Attachments: foundersedge_program_summary.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ngo <sarah@foundersedge.vc>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: cohort top-up — 50k credits per company?

Hi Sarah — thanks for reaching out and congrats on the new cohort. We can absolutely support partner top-ups and enable self-serve redemption for founders, pending a short eligibility verification.

High-level:
- We can provision a partner promo code (recommended: FE-AUTO-50K-2026) that will auto-issue 50k credits to each qualifying signup.
- Requirements we need to verify for each startup: company name, website/domain, CEO/lead founder email, incorporation jurisdiction, and a signed accelerator letter from Founders Edge confirming program acceptance.
- We typically cap program issuance at a single promo code per cohort; if you expect more than 12 companies please flag now.

Next steps for the fastest path (self-serve issuance):
1) Send a CSV with the roster (company, domain, founder email, incorporation_jurisdiction).
2) Provide a single signed accelerator letter (PDF) on Founders Edge letterhead that we can reference for onboarding.
3) Optional: cap table snapshot for higher-risk jurisdictions (screenshot OK).

I’ve copied our Partnerships lead Marissa Cole and our Compliance operations contact Monica Patel so they can confirm the program limits and enable the promo code in the portal once we have the docs.

Once we receive the roster + signed letter we can typically activate and issue credits within 48 business hours.

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Founders Edge cohort top-up request — approval for FE-AUTO-50K-2026?

Forwarding request from Founders Edge — they want 50k credits per company for ~12 companies, self-serve issuance.

Key asks:
- Approve promo code FE-AUTO-50K-2026 (50k/session per company, redemption window 180 days)
- Confirm required verification: roster CSV + signed accelerator letter. We may request cap table snapshots for specific companies from higher-risk jurisdictions.
- Approve total program cap: 12 x 50k = 600k credits (we could set a soft cap and monitor redemption).

Why this matters: Founders Edge is a well-regarded accelerator with a history of placing companies that convert to paid usage. This is a PLG motion to seed product adoption across their portfolio.

If you approve, I’ll send the checklist and the self-serve redemption link to Sarah and ask them to upload the roster/letters.

Thanks — Dev

Dev — thanks for the summary. Approve with conditions below.

Approved items:
- Promo code name FE-AUTO-50K-2026 is fine. Set per-company issuance 50,000 credits, expiry 180 days from issuance.
- Program cap: enable soft cap at 750k credits to provide buffer (we will monitor redemptions daily).
- Turn on automated issuance path in the portal once roster + signed letter are received.

Compliance & verification requirements (must be collected before issuance):
1) Single signed accelerator letter (PDF) on Founders Edge letterhead naming Redwood Inference as a partner and stating that listed companies are cohort participants.
2) Roster CSV: columns: company_name, domain, founder_email, incorporation_jurisdiction.
3) For companies incorporated outside US/UK/CA, request a cap table snapshot (screenshot or PDF) for basic fraud screening.

Operational notes:
- Please create HubSpot opportunity RE-2143 and attach any incoming docs there (I linked it above).
- For billing, mark these as marketing credits (non-refundable) and tag with promo_id FE-AUTO-50K-2026. Finance will reconcile via our regular partner credits process.

Dev, once you have the roster and signed letter, activate the promo link: https://app.redwood.ai/promo-issue/FE-AUTO-50K-2026 and cc Monica on the activation email so she can spot-check the first five redemptions.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
